description:
The Helo Text Formatter plugin takes any input text and converts it to uppercase instantly. 
It runs on the client side for fast performance and is useful for formatting user-generated content.
name: Helo Text Formatter
plugin_instructions:
1️⃣ Add this plugin to your Bubble app.  
2️⃣ Use the "Format text to uppercase" action in a workflow.  
3️⃣ Pass any text input and get the uppercase result instantly.  
4️⃣ Display the result using a Text element.
